image.alt: Family event · Washington, DC. DC's cherry blossom festival turns 100: 2027 dates are out. Checked on the official page November 4, 2026.

threads.text:
DC's cherry blossom festival turns 100: 2027 dates are out

When: Mar 20 to Apr 11, 2027. Kite festival Mar 27, parade Apr 10.

Cost: Kite festival and parade sidewalks free. Grandstand $28-$45 a seat before fees; some listings still say 2026.

Peak bloom averages Apr 3, but can't be called far ahead. We'd pick a refundable hotel.

Checked on nationalcherryblossomfestival.org on November 4.

#WashingtonDCWithKids
